Noticed there was no visible EasyPay Finance marketing displayed at the location. I had previously dropped off a QR code, but during this visit it was not visible or placed in plain sight. I offered additional marketing materials and reinforced the financing benefits we provide, including 90-day same-as-cash options and 12–24 month terms.

At this time, the merchant does not appear highly engaged or likely to generate significant usage. Based on the conversation and overall activity level, this would currently be considered a low-usage/low-volume opportunity.

Will maintain light follow-up touchpoints moving forward.

 I’ve been trying to connect with you to schedule your EasyPay training session. This training is an essential step to ensure your team is fully equipped to maximize the benefits of our platform and provide the best experience for customers.

Please reply to this email with your preferred date and time or give me a call at (866) 854-8555, and I’ll follow up with a meeting link for your preferred time.

 Our team is available Monday through Friday from 6 AM to 3:30 PM PT. Let us know what works best for you within this timeframe.

 Looking forward to hearing from you soon!

Best,
 Luzmam Vigil
 (858) 264-5167
 EasyPay Finance 
 EasyPay Finance: PO Box 2549 Carlsbad, CA 92018
For information regarding EasyPay Finance's Programs, visit https://www.easypayfinance.com/programs.
Email Preference Center

Full Comments:
Checked in via Maps Application 
Visited Sierra Auto Care and spoke with Maria. She shared that the shop stopped using EasyPay Finance after losing a spiff incentive back in December, which led them to begin utilizing a competitor program, believed to be Acima or Snap. She mentioned the competitor is currently offering a $15 incentive.

To help regain engagement and usage, I set the location up with a $20 spiff for the next 90 days. Based on the conversation, this should help drive renewed interest and increase funding activity from the account.

Set expectations that I will continue supporting the location with visits once or twice per quarter. Also provided Maria with my business card, dedicated QR code, pens, and additional marketing materials for the sales floor to improve visibility and customer application flow.

Completed onboarding with Renato. He was very friendly throughout the conversation and asked several detailed questions regarding the program and approval requirements for customers. I explained that EasyPay reviews multiple factors during the approval process, including credit history, income, recent credit activity, debt-to-income ratio, prior defaults, and ensuring the customer’s bank account has been active for at least 90 days.

I also emphasized the importance of tax exemption and ensuring taxes are not included on invoices, as EasyPay collects taxes directly from the customer. Additionally, we reviewed the requirement that all transactions must be completed in person, since EasyPay does not support online transactions.

We also discussed best practices for processing the $39 fee. Overall, Renato demonstrated a strong understanding of the process, especially since he already works with several financing providers such as Asima, Cfna, Snap Finance, and Progressive Leasing.

Checked in via Maps Application 
Account Visit – Panda’s Auto Repair (Rosecrans)

Stopped by Panda’s Auto Repair on Rosecrans and spoke with Gerardo regarding current financing activity and marketing support.

Gerardo shared that he enjoys using EasyPay Finance and continues to leverage the program consistently. The account has generated nearly $10,000 in funding over the last three months, including approximately $1,600 funded this month alone.

During the visit, Gerardo requested additional marketing materials, specifically banners. I informed him that banners are currently on backorder, but I will be placing an order for updated posters to support continued visibility in the shop.

Based on current usage and merchant feedback, the location appears to favor EasyPay Finance over Snap, which positions the account well for continued growth.

Overall, this is a strong-performing account with positive momentum, especially heading into the summer season when business activity is expected ...

Account Visit – Five Star Upholstery & Window Tint

Stopped by Five Star Upholstery & Window Tint and spoke with the owner and employees regarding account setup and financing usage.

During the visit, we confirmed that the business is already properly set up with the business portal and verified that the bank account information remains the same from the original setup.

I also printed and provided a dedicated EasyPay Finance QR code for customer applications to help improve visibility and streamline the financing process.

One positive takeaway is that there does not appear to be any competitor financing marketing at the location at this time.

Overall, the account appears properly positioned for future growth, and I am looking forward to seeing an increase in funding activity moving forward.

Plan is to continue supporting the merchant and monitor for increased application and funding volume.
